what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Burundi in Mozambique: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7451 Burundian asylum seekers in Mozambique, 11.5% of all asylum seekers from Burundi.
Refugees from Burundi, a separate group, live mostly in Tanzania, Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in periods from 1995 to 2024, most recently with RED-TABARA.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2015 to 2025, begin just after the 2014 to 2015 period of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 611 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 8969, at the end of 2022.
It was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mozambique.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Mozambique only.
